portraits.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production 2D character portrait PNG for a cozy fantasy anime visual novel, with a genuinely transparent alpha background.
Input image 1 is the CHARACTER IDENTITY reference: match that person's hair, skin tone, age, face, costume and generous stylized head proportions. Input image 2 is an ART STYLE reference only: the detailed anime painting of Mira in the approved classic dialogue mockup. Do not transfer Mira's identity, hairstyle or costume from image 2 to a different person.
Paint a newly illustrated high-definition waist-up portrait of ONE person, not an enlarged game sprite. Rich detailed hair strands, expressive shaded irises, clean confident linework, subtle painterly fabric folds, soft warm daylight, cozy hand-painted anime finish. Consistent rendering with the portrait in image 2. Keep the reference's friendly, stylized face with a generously proportioned head; do not turn the person into a photorealistic adult fashion model. This is a non-romantic village conversation.
Framing: portrait-oriented canvas around 1024x1536; complete head and hair and both shoulders, down to the waist/belt. Centre the body with 8% clear transparent margin above and at both sides, no clipped hair or elbows. Three-quarter front view turned slightly toward the viewer's right, looking warmly toward the viewer. Relaxed friendly explanatory expression, closed or gently smiling mouth, arms resting naturally, hands can be below the waist crop. No objects covering the face. Bottom waist edge can end cleanly behind the game's dialogue box.
Background must be truly TRANSPARENT, including corners and space around hair. No background painting, no gradient, no cast shadow backdrop, no checkerboard painted into the image. No frame, lettering, UI, watermark, extra people, accessories absent from the identity reference, or gameplay sprite. Only the isolated new portrait.
Subject: Mira, a friendly young female cartographer: warm medium brown skin, warm brown eyes, short wavy espresso bob, two brass hair clips on the viewer's left, ochre neck scarf, plum short coat, sage turned cuffs, cream trim and brown belt with brass buckle.
